headline.head: WHO ARE YOU?
headline.sub: Maye hung 39.46 on a 3-1 team. His loudest defender doesn't roster him, his loudest hater benched his own Bo Nix, and Alex collected the points.

jabs.lowball: $39 for a man who went for $96 and scored 28. The mattress wins again.
jabs.steal: Ninety-six dollars, twenty-eight points. The commish finally bought something that works.

paper.obituary: Started a ghost, benched a touchdown. Survived by Kyle Pitts, who did his job.

jokes.text: 🚨 Maye: 39.46, 374 yards, 4 TDs, zero picks, 45-17 over a Raiders team that came in 3-1. 'The Schedule' just scheduled a beating.

jokes.premise: Sam defends a QB he doesn't roster
jokes.text: Sam, Sunday 4:08pm: "Drake Maye didn't throw an Interception." Sam, for the record, does not roster Drake Maye. Alex does. Alex finished 3rd.
Ben, the league's loudest Maye hater, benched his own Bo Nix. Nix scored 7.92. Ben hates Maye so much he stopped believing in quarterbacks.

jokes.premise: Bo nix is on, eyes closed
jokes.text: The commish, 5:03pm: "@Ben Bo nix is on 👀". Ben: 🏈. Nix finished with 123 yards against the 0-5 Chargers. The 👀 have been closed.
Season: Maye 94.22, Nix 68.18. Ben has asked the league office to review strength of schedule. The league office is the commish. Denied.

jokes.premise: Pitts on the bench would have saved him
jokes.text: Riley started Dalton Kincaid (3.7) with Kyle Pitts (15.2) on the bench. Swap them and Riley lives at 82.7, and Matt goes home instead.
He also started Jordan Addison, who was listed OUT. A lineup with a ghost in it. Peter circled the Pitts in green; the Gazette would circle the whole thing.
Riley's own review: "the bills scored 37 and Kincaid couldn't get 13 points 💀". Accurate, Riley. You also started him.
The commish's $222 Kittle bought 7.4 points. The $96 Pickens dropped 28. Even the alleged collusion has bad ROI.
Jack's $59 Jalen Coker spent the week on bye. Jack has officially paid for a man's vacation.

jokes.premise: losing Harvey by $1 was his best move
jokes.text: The commish lost RJ Harvey to Matt by $1 last week. Harvey scored 0.7. Losing by a dollar is the best move the commish has made all year.
Matt's FAAB history, in full: one winning bid. $70 on RJ Harvey. Return: 0.7 points.
His defense in the group chat: "its called strategy 😎". The strategy finished 11th of 12 and survived by 7.82. Technically, it's working.

jokes.premise: Evans knows who he is, Jalijah knows now
jokes.text: Jalijah benched Mike Evans in Week 2 like he didn't know who he was. Evans: 26.3 this week. Jalijah: a league-high 159.76. He knows now.
Peter spent Tuesday morning circling Riley's bench in green, two days after his Eagles lost to the Jaguars. Glass houses, green circles.

jokes.premise: $48 waiver week, bidding war of the century
jokes.text: The whole league spent $48 on waivers. Kyle's $45 on Josh Downs was the week's biggest bid; Peter won Alvin Kamara for $3 over Jalijah's $0. Bidding war of the century.

jokes.premise: Sergio did not die in vain
jokes.text: Nobody started a player on bye. Sergio did not die in vain.
The Browns lost 17-12 to the Jets. Order has been restored in Ohio.

photo.caption: Sam explains strength of schedule to Ben.
